name: Punks Not Dead 💀
source: The cyber city has its neon parts and its shadows. So too does it have its cyber runners, and Blaze is one of them. Hot on the trail of something different, something resonant, Bonny’s sister Blaze seeks out those who are ‘special’, to do something special with and to them.
translation: 这座赛博都市既有霓虹璀璨的繁华街区，也有暗影重重的角落；同样，这里也活跃着各路赛博跑手，而布蕾兹正是其中一员。为了追寻某种与众不同、能激起共鸣的刺激，邦妮的姐妹布蕾兹四处物色那些“特别”的人，要与他们——并在他们身上——做些格外火辣的事。
